shared_elements: elongated linear objects (staff- or pole-like forms)
repeated row of similar figures forming a band
monochrome, uncoloured stone ground with figures reading as silhouettes
justification: Both surfaces present animals in strict profile and isolated disc shapes scattered across an undivided stone ground, and each has one zone where similar figures repeat in a row, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, painted/pecked open-field scene dominated by stick-like human figures and a large bovine on a horizontal rock face, while B is a vertically stacked, carved relief in raised three-dimensional modelling with registers of animals and no human actors.
